gloss: when the time comes; when the opportunity arises

definitions.gloss: when the time comes; when the opportunity arises; at the right moment
definitions.explanation: An expression meaning to wait for an appropriate moment before taking action. Implies patience and timing rather than immediate action.

examples.japanese: {折|おり}を{見|み}て⟦{相談|そうだん}します→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧。
examples.english: I'll consult with you when the time is right.

examples.japanese: {折|おり}を{見|み}て⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}しよう→報告する：05644_houkokusuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っている→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I'm planning to report to my supervisor when the opportunity arises.

examples.japanese: {忙|いそが}しそうだった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{折|おり}を{見|み}て⟦{声|こえ}をかける→声をかける：30589_koewokakeru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: Since they looked busy, I decided to speak to them when the moment was right.

notes:
A set expression built on ⟦{折|おり}→折：10250_ori⟧ (occasion, opportunity) and ⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧ (watching for). Expresses the idea of waiting for a suitable opening rather than acting immediately. Common in both business and everyday contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {折|おり}を{見|み}て + verb: to do something when the time is right
- {折|おり}を{見|み}て⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧: to tell someone when the opportunity arises
- {折|おり}を{見|み}て⟦{訪|たず}ねる→訪ねる：01182_tazuneru⟧: to visit when the time comes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧: when the opportunity comes — similar but slightly more formal
- ⟦{頃合|ころあ}い→頃合い：14688_koroai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧: judging the right moment — emphasizes reading the situation
- ⟦タイミング→タイミング：17683_taimingu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧: watching for the right timing — more casual, uses loanword
- ⟦{折|おり}に{触|ふ}れて→折に触れて：19487_orinifurete⟧: from time to time; whenever the occasion arises — means repeatedly, not just once

REGISTER:
Polite and measured. Often used in workplace communication to signal that one will act thoughtfully rather than rushing.
